signals_info.description: Signed lateral displacement of the vehicle center from the lane center.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At all times, the lane offset shall be greater than -0.3 meters and less than 0.3 meters.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在所有时刻，车道横向偏移应大于 -0.3 米且小于 0.3 米。
nl_Paraphrase_en: During lane-keeping control, the magnitude of the vehicle's lateral displacement from the lane center shall always be strictly less than 0.3 meters.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 车道保持控制期间，车辆相对车道中心的横向偏移绝对值应始终严格小于 0.3 米。
